description: This is the main server implementation for the Battle for Wesnoth game, handling network connections, player login, game management, and command processing.

classes.name: server
classes.description: Main server class managing network connections, player sessions, game instances, and administrative commands.

methods.name: server::server
methods.description: Constructor initializing server with port, input stream, configuration, and thread count.

methods.name: server::run
methods.description: Main server loop accepting connections, processing data, and handling server commands.

methods.name: server::process_data
methods.description: Dispatches incoming data to appropriate handlers based on connection state.

methods.name: server::process_login
methods.description: Handles player login, version validation, and initial setup.

methods.name: server::process_query
methods.description: Processes administrative or server queries from clients.

methods.name: server::process_data_from_player_in_lobby
methods.description: Handles game creation, joining, messaging, and lobby updates.

methods.name: server::process_data_from_player_in_game
methods.description: Handles in-game commands, game state updates, player bans, and game termination.

methods.name: server::delete_game
methods.description: Removes a game instance and updates server state.

methods.name: server::sync_initial_response
methods.description: Creates a diff of the current game list for synchronization.

methods.name: server::dump_stats
methods.description: Outputs server statistics to standard output.

methods.name: server::process_command
methods.description: Executes administrative commands like messaging, banning, kicking, and status reporting.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point initializing server configuration, parsing command-line options, and starting the server loop.
